rows.heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence
rows.excerpt: local pct pct=$(( (200 * killed + total) / (2 * total) )) if [[ "$inconcl" -gt 0 ]]; then printf 'MUTATE: DEGRADED (target=%s defects=%s killed=%s survived=%s inconclusive=%s kill-rate=%s%%)\n' \ "$LABEL" "$total" "$kill
rows.reader: L1 TameshiR49 (pointer introduced by correction from T49SecRecipe)
rows.note: kill-rate pct is computed over total (every defect) and an inconclusive run makes the sweep DEGRADED, exit 1
